stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 24.

The flit of the butterflies moved into her, then out into the brush, so the paint seemed to lay itself down.

Why does the author use figurative language in this sentence?

options.label: F
options.text: To show the way Noi captures the motions of a butterfly in her painting

options.label: G
options.text: To explain why Noi is able to paint a butterfly without looking at her brush

options.label: H
options.text: To suggest that Noi allows a butterfly to land on her as she paints its image

options.label: J
options.text: To emphasize how Noi uses simple strokes to paint an image of a butterfly

visual_elements: The flit of the butterflies moved into her, then out into the brush, so the paint seemed to lay itself down.
